name: github_create_or_update_file
description: Create or update a single file in a repository, which produces a commit (the simplest way to push a change). `content` MUST be the new file contents encoded as base64. To update (not create) an existing file you MUST pass its current `sha` (get it from github_get_file_contents) or GitHub rejects the write. Provide `owner`, `repo`, `path`, `message` (commit message), `content` (base64); optional `branch` (defaults to the default branch) and `sha` (required for updates).

path.description: Path of the file to create/update within the repo.

branch.description: Optional branch to commit to. Defaults to the default branch.

sha.description: The blob SHA of the file being replaced. REQUIRED when updating an existing file; omit when creating a new file.
